name: 89138 · Las Vegas, NV
findings: ZIP 89138 (Las Vegas) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89138 (Las Vegas) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89138 (Las Vegas) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 30% of the typical level).
